  • 10,000–100,000 NKN: X=5
  • 100,000–1,000,000 NKN: X=6
  • 1,000,000+ NKN: X=7

Q: How does the consecutive days streak work?
 A: Your streak multiplier (Y) equals the number of consecutive days you’ve opened the app, up to a maximum of 7. Each day you open the app, your streak increases by 1. If you miss a day, your streak resets to 0.

Q: What happens when I complete a 7-day streak?
 A: When you complete a full 7-day streak, your streak multiplier will remain at 7 as long as you continue checking in daily.

Q: Do I need to do anything special to “check in” each day?
 A: simply opening the nMobile app and interacting with the nMobile Rewards bot counts as your daily check-in.

Q: What time does the daily check-in reset?
 A: Check-ins reset at midnight UTC. You can check in anytime during a 24-hour period.

Examples

Q: Can you provide some examples of how the points are calculated?
 A: Sure!

Example 1:

  • Lisa checks in for the first time and has 5 NKN
  • X=1 (1–10 NKN tier), Y=1 (first day of streak)
  • Points earned: 1*1*100 = 100 points

Example 2:

  • David has checked in for 3 consecutive days
  • He holds 523 NKN in the app
  • X=3 (100–1,000 NKN tier), Y=3 (3-day streak)
  • Points earned: 3*3*100 = 900 points

Example 3:

  • Michael has a 7-day streak (maximum)
  • He holds 15,000 NKN
  • X=5 (10,000–100,000 NKN tier), Y=7 (7-day streak)
  • Points earned: 5*7*100 = 3,500 points

Redeeming Points

Q: What can I redeem my points for?
 A: You can redeem points for:

  • Exclusive in-app features and customizations
  • Conversion to additional NKN tokens (up to 1M NKN tokens for first season)

Q: How do I redeem my points?
 A: Details about points redemption will be announced at the end of the campaign.

Q: Do my points expire?
 A: Points remain valid for 12 months from the date they were earned. We’ll notify you before any points are about to expire.

Q: Can I transfer my points to another user?
 A: Currently, points cannot be transferred between users.

Technical Details

Q: What happens if I add or remove NKN from my wallet?
 A: Your NKN holdings multiplier is calculated based on the amount in your wallet at the time of daily check-in. Adding more NKN could increase your multiplier for the next day’s check-in.

Q: Will my streak be lost if there’s app maintenance?
 A: No. If nMobile undergoes scheduled maintenance, we’ll ensure all active users maintain their streaks.

Q: What if I change devices or reinstall the app?
 A: Your rewards account is tied to your nMobile wallet address, not your device. As long as you log in with the same wallet, your points and streak will be preserved. So please back up your nMobile wallet secret key.

Troubleshooting

Q: I checked in but didn’t receive my points. What should I do?
 A: First, ensure your app is updated to the latest version, you have nMobile Rewards bot in your contact list, and you are in a chat thread with the bot. If the issue persists, please contact support with your nMobile account address, the date and approximate time of your check-in.

Q: My NKN holdings aren’t reflected correctly in my multiplier. Why?
 A: There may be a slight delay in updating your holdings multiplier. If the issue persists for more than 24 hours, please contact support.

Program Updates

Q: Will the rewards program ever change?
 A: We may periodically update the program to improve user experience based on feedback. Any significant changes will be announced at least 7 days in advance.

Q: How will I know about special point promotions or events?
 A: Special promotions will be announced through push notifications, in-app messages, email (if you’ve opted in), and our social media channels.

Q: Where can I provide feedback about nMobile Rewards?
 A: We welcome your feedback! Please use the “Contact” option in the app settings or email us at nmobile@nkn.org .

Privacy and Security

Q: Does participating in nMobile Rewards share any personal data?
 A: No personal data is collected beyond your nMobile account’s public information. We only track app usage and NKN holdings to calculate your rewards.

Q: How secure are my points?
 A: Your points are securely stored on our servers, hardened with regular backups.

If you have any questions not covered in this FAQ, please contact our support team at nmobile@nkn.org.

item.title: Public Statement Regarding NKN’s Monitoring Tag on Binance
item.dc:creator: NKN
item.content:encoded:
On April 3, 2025, Binance assigned a “Monitoring” tag to NKN, indicating that the token will undergo closer scrutiny due to higher volatility and Binance’s internal risk factors. This designation does not equate to a delisting but serves as a cautionary signal to investors. Tokens with this tag are subject to regular reviews to ensure they continue to meet Binance’s listing criteria.

The NKN project remains fundamentally robust, operating the world’s largest decentralized network with over 55,000 active consensus nodes globally. We view this development as an impetus to intensify our efforts in several key areas throughout 2025:

  • Expanding Universal Communication Services for AI Agents: Accelerating the development of communication solutions tailored for AI applications.
  • Integrating with the Solana Blockchain: Enhancing interoperability by introducing support for the Solana network.
  • Advancing HomeNet and Satellite Projects: Transitioning these initiatives from beta phases to general public releases.
  • Boosting Community Engagement: Strengthening relationships with developers and users through improved support and timely communication.

In response to feedback from Binance, we are prioritizing:

  • Demonstrating Mainnet Adoption: Showcasing increased utilization of our mainnet by both NKN-developed and community-built decentralized applications (dApps).
  • Enhancing Token Liquidity: Implementing strategies to improve the liquidity of NKN tokens.

We acknowledge the concerns this situation may raise within our community. Please rest assured that we are fully committed to addressing the factors highlighted by Binance to not only maintain our listing but to emerge stronger. We encourage our community members to remain engaged and supportive as we navigate this period.

Our long-term vision remains steadfast: to build the world’s leading decentralized communication network serving both humans and AI agents. To achieve this, we will continue to focus on our strategic objectives while implementing visible actions that demonstrate the capabilities and potential of the NKN network. Our vibrant community plays a crucial role in this endeavor, and we are committed to showcasing what is possible through collaborative efforts and innovative applications.

NKN continues to make significant strides in decentralised communication, reflecting strong adoption and achieving notable milestones. Below, we highlight how users actively engage with NKN’s network, showcase recent accomplishments, and provide exciting updates from our vibrant community.

Growing Product Adoption

Unlike traditional blockchain projects, NKN primarily focuses on off-chain data transmission, making our key metrics relay messages, SDK users, and active nodes. The network currently manages an impressive 400,000 messages per second, amounting to around 35 billion messages daily — a testament to our robust infrastructure. You can view real-time statistics through our open-source network crawler.

Additionally, engagement with our SDK remains high, with 23,557 daily active users recorded on March 5–6, 2025, highlighting the growing popularity and practical utility of NKN-powered dApps.

Daily Active Wallets:

- March 5, 2025: 3,555 wallets

- March 4, 2025: 1,789 wallets

With 50,000–65,000 active mining nodes daily, our ecosystem demonstrates robust on-chain health. Monitor active wallets here.

dApps Adoption: Ecosystem Growth

- nMobile v1.6 released: Enhanced user experience across GitHub, iOS, and Android.

- Successful NKN-Solana swap test: Expanding our cross-chain interoperability.

- Novon.tv received NKN Foundation Award: Recognised for community contribution.

- Regular engineering updates demonstrate continuous commitment to innovation.

Open Source Development

- nMobile v1.6: Major upgrade enhancing privacy and usability.

Clear and Transparent Roadmap

Our commitment to transparency means our community always knows what’s next. Check our comprehensive “2024 mid-term roadmap” to stay informed.
